propositions: Rename the canonical acceptance-criteria qualifier from [operator-attested] to [non-codebase] to correctly signal that evidence lives outside the codebase, not that a human must attest
Maintain backward compatibility by accepting both [non-codebase] and [operator-attested] spellings case-insensitively in the shared regex pattern using non-capturing alternation

Widen the .rebar/criteria_routing.json activation trigger and all recognition-side prompts to accept both tag spellings so [non-codebase]-tagged plans do not silently skip the measurement-provenance criterion
Sequence reader-widening of kind-value comparison in audit/page.py before emitter-side cutover to prevent 827 legacy tickets with operator-attested verdicts from breaking
Update all author-facing documentation to emit [non-codebase] only while retaining [operator-attested] as an undocumented compatibility alias in code and fixtures
Create ADR-0101 to document the rename rationale and retain [operator-attested] as deliberate undocumented alias, amending ADR-0043
